steps.evidence: composer.json:39 (setup script); .env.example:30,40 use database sessions/cache on SQLite, so tables must exist. migrate offers to create the missing database/database.sqlite (default yes)
composer.json:40 (setup script); composer.json:43-46 dev script runs `artisan dev`, which also starts Vite

optionalSteps.evidence: composer.json:41 (setup script); welcome.blade.php:12 falls back when no build/hot exists, and `composer run dev` serves assets through Vite

notes: This is the bare Laravel application skeleton. The README has no local-setup section, only links to laravel.com, and its two commands (composer require laravel/boost --dev, php artisan boost:install) are for optional AI-agent tooling, not setup. The canonical sequence is the composer `setup` script (composer install, copy .env, key:generate, migrate --force, npm install --ignore-scripts, npm run build), so `composer run setup` does every step above in one go. CI only goes as far as key:generate because tests run on in-memory SQLite. There is no lockfile, so npm is inferred from the scripts. No Node version is stated anywhere. Port 8000 comes from APP_URL and artisan serve's default.
